topic: Write a Part-time Job Application Letter(写一封兼职求职信)
title_en: Application for a Part-time Tour Guide
genre: 应用文 / 求职信(application letter:state the position + relevant experience + qualifications + restate interest)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第四册 Unit 1 Writing an application letter:为兼职岗位写一封正式求职信(说明应聘职位与来源、相关经历、个人优势、礼貌结尾)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫 Li Hua,你在校园网上看到一则兼职招聘:City Tours Agency 招聘周末兼职导游(part-time local tour guide)。请用英语写一封约100词的求职信,内容包括:① 说明应聘的职位及从何处得知;② 你为何适合这份工作(对家乡历史的了解、英语能力);③ 相关经历(曾为外国朋友做过城市导览);④ 礼貌结尾并留下联系方式。注意:用正式书信格式,时态使用正确(past/present/future 各得其所)。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. You saw an advertisement on the school website: City Tours Agency wants a part-time local tour guide for weekends. Write an application letter (about 100 words) including: 1) the position and where you learnt about it; 2) why you are suitable (knowledge of your home city's history, your English); 3) relevant experience (you once guided foreign friends around your city); 4) a polite ending with your contact information. Use a formal letter format and the correct tenses.
points: 说明应聘职位与信息来源(I am writing to apply for ... as advertised on ...)
陈述个人优势:对家乡历史的了解 + 英语能力(present)
陈述相关经历(past:I once organised ...)
礼貌结尾、表达期待并留联系方式(future:I would welcome the chance to ...)
model_essay:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the position of a part-time tour guide, as advertised on our school website. As I plan to work in the tourism industry one day, I would welcome this opportunity.

I know almost every corner of my home city and have a real passion for its history. I can also speak English fluently, which will help me serve foreign visitors well. Last summer, I organised a tour of the old town for some exchange students, and they gave me very warm feedback.

I would be delighted to discuss my application further. You can reach me at lihua@email.com.

Yours faithfully,
Li Hua
model_translation:
尊敬的先生/女士:

我写信申请贵社兼职导游一职,该招聘信息见于我校校园网。由于我打算将来从事旅游业,我非常珍惜这次机会。

我熟悉家乡的几乎每个角落,并对它的历史充满热情。我英语流利,这有助于我更好地服务外国游客。去年夏天,我曾为一些交换生组织了一次老城游览,他们给了我非常热情的反馈。

我很乐意进一步面谈我的申请。您可通过 lihua@email.com 与我联系。

谨上
李华

rubric.criteria: 四要素齐全:职位与来源 / 个人优势 / 相关经历 / 礼貌结尾+联系方式
正式书信格式、分段清楚、首尾呼应、行文连贯
时态正确(过去经历用一般过去时、能力用现在时、意愿用 will/would)、句式词汇多样、基本无语法错误

required_structure: 称呼 Dear Sir or Madam,
目的 I am writing to apply for the position of ... as advertised on ...
优势 I know my home city well and can speak English fluently.
经历 Last summer, I organised a tour for some exchange students.
结尾 I would be delighted to discuss my application further. Yours faithfully, Li Hua
key_expressions: I am writing to apply for the position of a part-time tour guide.
I have a real passion for the history of my home city.
Last summer, I organised a tour of the old town for exchange students.
I would welcome the opportunity to gain experience in this field.

high_sentences: I am writing to apply for the position of a part-time tour guide, as advertised on our school website.
I know almost every corner of my home city and have a real passion for its history.
Last summer, I organised a tour of the old town for some exchange students.
I would be delighted to discuss my application further.

error_pairs.wrong: I am writing to apply the position.
error_pairs.correct: I am writing to apply for the position.
error_pairs.note: apply for sth 固定搭配,不可漏 for。

error_pairs.wrong: Last summer I organise a tour for students.
error_pairs.correct: Last summer I organised a tour for students.
error_pairs.note: Last summer 表过去,谓语用一般过去时。

error_pairs.wrong: I will welcome the opportunity to discussing it.
error_pairs.correct: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss it.
error_pairs.note: 婉转表愿望用 would;opportunity to do sth 后接动词原形。
